mapper.insert: INSERT INTO b_official_handover_log SET gmt_create = now(), gmt_modify = now(), official_id = #{officialId}, new_official_id =#{newOfficialId}, service_order_id=#{serviceOrderId}
mapper.select: SELECT official_id FROM b_official_handover_log WHERE service_order_id = #{serviceOrderId} ORDER BY gmt_modify desc limit 1
SELECT service_order_id AS serviceOrderId, official_id AS officialId FROM b_official_handover_log WHERE service_order_id IN #{id}
